uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Honedge and Doublade do not gain the stat benefits of Stance Change; their auto attacks act like Aegislash's Sword Forme auto attacks. Honedge and Doublade do not gain the stat benefits of Stance Change. However, their boosted attack functions like Aegislash's Sword Stance boosted attack.

When in Sword Forme: slashes at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. When in Shield Forme: rams at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. Becomes a boosted attack if the boost count is at 1 or more, consuming 1 boost count; the boosted attack changes based on the current Forme. The boost count caps at 4, and boosted attacks remain readied until used. As a boosted attack in Sword Forme: pierces through the target, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. As a boosted attack in Shield Forme: slams into the target, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and stunning them for 0.1s; restores HP, and reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sword or Shadow Claw by 1s when it hits. Slash at enemies in front of Aegislash, dealing damage to them. If the boost count is one or more, basic attacks become a boosted attack. When in Blade Stance: pierce through enemies, dealing damage. When in Shield Stance: ram enemies, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for a short time, restore HP, and reduce the cooldown of Sacred Sword and Shadow Claw when this attack hits. Every boosted attack consumes one boost count. Up to 4 boosted boosted attacks can be stored.

Deals an additional 8.5% of the enemies Max HP as damage. Against Wild Pokemon: The additional damage from maximum HP is capped at 1000. Slash at enemies in front of Aegislash, dealing damage to them. If the boost count is one or more, basic attacks become a boosted attack. When in Blade Stance: pierce through enemies, dealing damage. When in Shield Stance: ram enemies, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for a short time, restore HP, and reduce the cooldown of Sacred Sword and Shadow Claw when this attack hits. Every boosted attack consumes one boost count. Up to 4 boosted boosted attacks can be stored.

Casts a shadow toward the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. After hitting an opposing Pokémon or traveling maximum distance; warps to the shadow’s location, damaging opposing Pokémon at the location. Increases the boost count by 1 if the warp hits an opposing Pokémon. Cast a shadow in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. After the shadow hits an enemy or travels its maximum distance, Aegislash warps to the shadow’s location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and increase boost count by 1.

Thrusts their blade into the ground and creates a triangular zone that erupts with a hidden power, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 0.6s. At the same time as the eruption, slashes forward, dealing more damage to opposing Pokémon hit; and increasing Defense penetration by 25% for 3s if the slash hits. Increases the boost count by 1 for each target hit by the triangular zone erupting (up to 2 from hitting wild Pokémon). Aegislash thrusts its blade into the ground, creating a triangular zone. This zone erupts with a hidden power, dealing damage to enemies in the area and throws them. Also increases boost count by 1 for each enemy hit (capped at 2 for wilds, 4 for players). At the same time as the eruption, Aegislash slashes forward, dealing additional damage to enemies hit. For a short time after this slash hits, damage dealt by Aegislash partially ignores the Defense of all enemies.
Increases Attack by 50 for 3s after the triangular zone hits. Increase Attack for a short time after hitting enemies with this move.

Slashes forward with their blade twice, damaging opposing Pokémon with each attack, then follows up with a final rising slash, damaging opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.75s when the rising slash hits. Increases the boost count by 1 if this move hits. Aegislash slashes with its blade twice in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Follow up with a final rising slash that deals damage to enemies hit and throw them. Boost count increases by 1 when at least one of the three slashes hits.
Increases critical-hit rate by 20% for 1s after the final slash. Increases Critical-Hit Rate with all attacks and moves except for Coup de Grace for a short time.

Envelops the user in a powerful protective force for up to 3s, blocking the next attack. Increases the boost count by 1 when this move blocks an attack. Envelops Aegislash in a powerful protective force for 1s. The protection disappears after blocking one attack or after 1s and then increases boost count by 1.

Focuses in place, becomes unstoppable and grants a shield effect for up to 1.2s; and shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s. This move can be used again to end the move early. When the shield effect is depleted or the move ends; shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s and decreases their movement speed by 45% for 2s. Increases the boost count by 1 unconditionally when granting the shield effect. Increases the boost count by 1 more for each instance of damage received by the shield effect (up to 2 times). Increases boost count by 1 more if an opposing Pokémon is shoved at the end or unconditionally when the shield effect is depleted before it can end normally. 8.5% max HP Focus in place for a short time to create a great shield on Aegislash. When this shield appears, boost count increases by 1, granting a shield to Aegislash and shoves enemies in front. While this shield is active, enemy player attacks increase boost count by 1 for each different enemy player (capping at 4). When this move ends, shove enemies in front of Aegislash once again.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Cooldown reduced by 1s.

Dashes barreling forward, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Protects the user with a special shield for 1s afterward; this shield blocks the damage of the next attack then disappears; reducing this move's cooldown by 3s after a successful block. Increases the boost count by 1 unconditionally after barreling forward. Increases the boost count by 1 more if the shield blocks an attack. Dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Also increases boost count by 1, and protects Aegislash with a special shield for a short time afterward. This shield doesn’t protect from hindrances, but it can nullify damage. When the shield blocks an attack, it disappears and boost count is increased by 1.
Increases Attack by 10% for 3s when the special shield blocks an attack. Increase Attack for a short time after blocking an attack.

Becomes unstoppable and unleashes a ground-splitting slash in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the line area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage to those hit. Increases the boost count by 2 if this Unite Move knocks out an opposing Pokémon. 12% missing HP as damage. Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from missing HP is capped at 1000. Unleash a ground-splitting slash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The lower their remaining HP, the more damage this move deals. If this slash knocks out an enemy, boost count increases by 1.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Wide Guard
source.originalDescription: Focuses in place, becomes unstoppable and grants a shield effect for up to 1.2s; and shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s. This move can be used again to end the move early. When the shield effect is depleted or the move ends; shoves opposing Pokémon in front for 0.6s and decreases their movement speed by 45% for 2s. Increases the boost count by 1 unconditionally when granting the shield effect. Increases the boost count by 1 more for each instance of damage received by the shield effect (up to 2 times). Increases boost count by 1 more if an opposing Pokémon is shoved at the end or unconditionally when the shield effect is depleted before it can end normally. 8.5% max HP Focus in place for a short time to create a great shield on Aegislash. When this shield appears, boost count increases by 1, granting a shield to Aegislash and shoves enemies in front. While this shield is active, enemy player attacks increase boost count by 1 for each different enemy player (capping at 4). When this move ends, shove enemies in front of Aegislash once again.
